profile_text.body:
SoundHound AI, Inc. is a public company headquartered in Claymont, Delaware, trading under the ticker SOUN. According to its website, its OASYS platform powers voice-native AI agents that handle service, operations, and commerce conversations for enterprise brands. The site describes the technology as conversational AI agents for the real world, with quoted customers saying the agentic AI resolves more requests faster, helps franchisees process orders more efficiently during peak hours, and supports always-on voice experiences through hybrid cloud and embedded connectivity.

The company's own materials position it around voice AI for enterprise use, including order processing and customer service. No products are tracked in the held records, and no lawsuits or MCP servers are listed. The records note a law exposure count of 33 in Delaware.
